reason: The report is not published; GAO's description of it is the only public account. It stays in the evidence register because it is the study under assessment, but no Claim in this record rests on it: its pointer is a recorded gap, and a claim resting on evidence whose metadata nobody outside the Army can see is exactly what the scope checker is right to refuse. Demonstration A hits the same mechanism with the Army's Milestone A analysis of alternatives.
